question_record.context: A security incident was reported involving Julian Burke (IT director) who sent a replication request to VNEVADO-DC from the machine VNEVADO-Win10V, which is suspected to be a DCSync attack. During the investigation, it was found that Ethan Brooks (Account Executive) on the same machine enumerated SMB sessions on VNEVADO-DC to retrieve IP addresses of 2 accounts. Ultimately, there was a detection of a command line execution of a known malicious credential theft tool that indicated an intent to dump users' credentials, keys, and plain-text passwords.
question_record.question: What is the identifier (Name) of the account from the final alert associated with the execution of the malicious credential theft tool?
solution: Julian Burke (IT director) on host `VNEVADO-Win10V` sent 1 replication request to `VNEVADO-DC`, indicating a suspected DCSync attack.

Ethan Brooks (Account Executive) on host `VNEVADO-Win10V` enumerated SMB sessions on `VNEVADO-DC`, retrieving recent IP addresses of 2 accounts. The AadUserId associated with this activity is `1d94aaf6-efe6-4e76-ad56-ffd7d1257bc1`.
A malicious credential theft tool execution was detected with the intent to dump users' credentials. The account linked to this activity is `tgs2z`.

A known credential theft tool execution command line was detected.
Either the process itself or its command line indicated an intent to dump users' credentials, keys, plain-text passwords and more.

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID' AND o.Concept = 'Host_Name'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
